entries.reason: Finally liquidated (more than 180 days, no protest). plan.headline: Prioritize the entries with the earliest deadlines and confirm each next step with your broker. This is not legal advice.

steps.title: File HP7-0414106-2 in CAPE immediately
steps.detail: Ask your broker to submit this entry through CAPE, the refund filing process; it appears eligible for $6,780. The deadline is Oct 24, 2026.

steps.title: File HP7-0414533-5 in CAPE
steps.detail: This entry appears eligible for $13,230 through CAPE. Ask your broker to file by Nov 16, 2026.

steps.title: File a protest for HP7-0413540-6
steps.detail: This entry appears eligible for $3,640, but the rules engine routes it to a protest, a formal challenge, rather than CAPE. Ask your broker to file by Nov 22, 2026.

steps.title: Correct HP7-0414879-0, then file in CAPE
steps.detail: The goods value needs to be moved from the Chapter 99 tariff line to the Chapter 1-97 tariff line before CAPE will accept the entry; it appears eligible for $4,460. Ask your broker to make the correction and file by Nov 30, 2026.

steps.title: File a protest for HP7-0413822-4
steps.detail: This entry appears eligible for $15,840, but the rules engine routes it to a protest rather than CAPE. Ask your broker to file by Dec 12, 2026.

steps.title: File HP7-0415250-8 in CAPE
steps.detail: This entry appears eligible for $3,880 through CAPE. Ask your broker to file by Dec 21, 2026.

steps.title: File a protest for HP7-0414117-9
steps.detail: This entry appears eligible for $3,750, but the rules engine routes it to a protest rather than CAPE. Ask your broker to file by Jan 31, 2027.

steps.title: File HP7-0415702-7 in CAPE
steps.detail: This entry appears eligible for $7,740 through CAPE. Ask your broker to file it now; the rules engine lists no deadline.

steps.title: Get the entry summary for HP7-0416475-1
steps.detail: The $3,180 amount appears only in a broker statement, so ask your broker for the entry summary to confirm it. Then ask them to file the entry in CAPE.

steps.title: Ask your broker about HP7-0416018-4
steps.detail: The rules engine says a surety paid the $3,975, so do not file this entry in CAPE. Ask your broker to confirm the payment and advise on the next step.

steps.title: Monitor the court process for these entries
steps.detail: The rules engine routes these entries to a class-member refund that is pending, with no refund order yet; it also notes the class may not cover goods from Brazil or India. Ask your broker to monitor for updates about the $4,125 and $2,860 amounts.

steps.title: No refund action for HP7-0411873-2
steps.detail: The rules engine says no IEEPA duty was paid on this entry, so there is nothing to refund for it.

plan.broker_email_subject: Please review IEEPA refund entries and deadlines
plan.broker_email_body:
Hello,

Please review these entries and confirm the filing steps and deadlines. The entries routed to CAPE appear eligible, but I understand a refund is not guaranteed.

- Please file HP7-0414106-2 in CAPE for $6,780 by Oct 24, 2026, and HP7-0414533-5 for $13,230 by Nov 16, 2026.
- Please file protests for HP7-0413540-6 ($3,640) by Nov 22, 2026, HP7-0413822-4 ($15,840) by Dec 12, 2026, and HP7-0414117-9 ($3,750) by Jan 31, 2027.
- For HP7-0414879-0 ($4,460), please move the goods value from the Chapter 99 tariff line to the Chapter 1-97 tariff line, then file it in CAPE by Nov 30, 2026.
- Please file HP7-0415250-8 ($3,880) in CAPE by Dec 21, 2026, and HP7-0415702-7 ($7,740) in CAPE now.
- For HP7-0416475-1, please send me the entry summary so I can confirm the $3,180 amount, then file it in CAPE.
- Please confirm that a surety paid the $3,975 for HP7-0416018-4 and advise on the correct next step; the rules engine says not to file it in CAPE.
- Please let me know how you will monitor the pending court process for HP7-0412207-3 ($4,125) and HP7-0412988-1 ($2,860).
- The rules engine says there is nothing to refund for HP7-0411873-2 because no IEEPA duty was paid.

Please confirm which actions you will handle and any information you need from me.

[Your name]
Lotus Tile & Stone LLC
